dedupe_keys.name: python microgrid modular energy system simulator

description: python-microgrid is Alex Halev and contributors' extension of TotalEnergies' pymgrid for generating and simulating local energy systems. It composes modules for loads, renewable generation, generators, batteries and grid exchange, with explicit balancing of supply-demand mismatches. Users supply component limits, costs, time series and control actions; outputs include stepwise energy balances, rewards and logs. Geographic coverage and temporal detail follow the supplied series. Public source and Python installation are free under LGPL-3.0. A limitation is that results reflect the chosen module abstractions and forecasts; a synthetic example or preconfigured microgrid does not establish the characteristics of a real site. The package retains the pymgrid import namespace, which users must distinguish from upstream versions. It can support local dispatch and storage-control simulations, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa). The README demonstrates module construction and stepwise control and links technical documentation. No load profiles, benchmark archive or package environment was downloaded.
